contentText:
Sydney Bradley / Business Insider :

Instagram launched Instants, an app for sharing disappearing photos, in Italy this week, after rolling out an Instants feature in its main app in some regions   —  - Instagram launched a new app in Italy this week called “Instants.”  — A hodgepodge of apps like Snapchat, Locket, and BeReal, the app is meant to be “low-pressure.”
